Master.g1.label: Request submitted

intake.submission_channels.summary: An agency shall permit receipt of written requests by e-mail or facsimile in addition to other approved methods, provided the agency uses e-mail or facsimile in the normal course of its business.

intake.oral_request_permitted.summary: A request may be made to the custodian orally or in writing; an oral request is a valid intake path (though it does not unlock the statutory enforcement remedies — see GA-0007).

intake.form_permitted.summary: An agency may (but is not obligated to) require that all written requests be directed to a designated official chosen from an enumerated list (director/chair/CEO, senior satellite official, designated records custodian clerk, or designated open records officer).

Master.g1.city_config: Which channels the city actually operates (portal / form / paper / phone) — statute constrains, city chooses.

Master.g4.city_config: Auto-acknowledgment text + send timing; statutory ack window where present, else city default (recommend: same business day).

redaction.segregability.summary: Exemptions are interpreted narrowly to exclude only the portion of a record to which an exclusion is directly applicable, and the agency having custody has a duty to provide all other portions of the record for inspection or copying.

Redaction.r1.city_config: The exemption library content (shared with Denial.nreason); segregability default applies in 25 states.

Redaction.d3.city_config: Legal-review escalation trigger for redactions — pure city policy (recommend: any novel exemption or protected-person class).

production.format_and_medium.summary: A requester may request that electronic records, data, or data fields be produced in the format in which the agency keeps them, or in a standard export format such as a flat-file ASCII format, if the agency's existing computer programs support such export; and the agency shall produce electronic …

production.inspection_access.summary: At the time of inspection, any person may make photographic copies or other electronic reproductions of the records using suitable portable devices brought to the place of inspection.
An agency may, in its discretion, provide copies of a record in lieu of providing access to the record when portions contain confidential information that must be redacted.

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: No public officer or agency is required to prepare new reports, summaries, or compilations not in existence at the time of the request.

An agency shall not refuse to produce electronic records, data, or data fields on the ground that exporting or redacting requires inputting range, search, filter, or report commands, so long as those commands can be executed using existing programs the agency uses in the ordinary course of business.

intake.purpose_and_certification.summary: Requests by civil litigants for records sought for use in ongoing civil or administrative litigation against the agency shall be made in writing and copied to the agency's counsel of record contemporaneously; the agency shall provide duplicate sets of produced records to that counsel at no cost u…

eligibility.any_person.summary: All public records are open for personal inspection and copying by any person, except records specifically exempted by court order or by law; no requester qualification is imposed for general access.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A requester need not state a reason or purpose to obtain general public records; a purpose/'need' showing is required only for enumerated special record types (e.g., motor vehicle accident reports).

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: There is no Georgia residency or citizenship condition on the right to request public records; the right runs to any person.

Master.s1.label: Fee-waiver requested
Master.s1.city_config: fee_waiver approval module (v1, DESIGN_fee_waiver_commercial.md): enabled on/off governs the DISCRETIONARY program only — statutory-mandatory waiver categories fire regardless, on verified evidence. mode = intake_review (inline approve/deny) | routed_task {assignee_role, task_name}.

Master.s2.city_config: commercial_rate approval module (v1): same two modes as fee_waiver (intake_review | routed_task). custody.contractor_and_thirdparty_custod.summary: If an agency contracts with a private vendor to collect or maintain public records, the agency shall ensure the arrangement does not limit public access and that the vendor does not impede record access or the method of delivery established by the agency or by law.

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: In addition to labor charges, an agency may charge for copying, not to exceed 10 cents per page for letter or legal size documents, or the actual cost of producing the copy for other document types.

fee.labor_charge.summary: An agency may impose a reasonable charge for search, retrieval, and redaction, but that charge shall not exceed the prorated hourly salary of the lowest paid full-time employee who, in the custodian's reasonable discretion, has the necessary skill and training to perform the request.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: An agency shall utilize the most economical means reasonably calculated to identify and produce responsive, nonexcluded documents.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: For electronic records, the agency may charge the actual cost of the media on which the records or data are produced.

fee.free_allowance.summary: No labor charge may be made for the first quarter hour of search, retrieval, or redaction.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: Where a specific fee for certified copies or other records is authorized or prescribed by law, that specific fee applies instead of the general search/retrieval/copy charges when such records are sought.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: An agency that designates one or more open records officers shall make the designation in writing, immediately provide notice of them to any person on request (orally or in writing), notify the county legal organ, and, if it has a website, prominently display the designation.
